subject: Kickoff: MULLER learned resizer for retrieval pipelines
body:
Hi Deshawn,

Kicking off MULLER (Mar 23 – Jun 1) — a short, sharp one. The asset is our ICCV 2023 open-source release: a multilayer Laplacian resizer, a learned resizing layer with a handful of parameters that sharpens the band-pass detail that downstream vision models actually use. Because it's so small it drops into existing preprocessing with effectively zero serving-cost delta, and the released demo notebook shows the integration in a few lines.

Product case: the retrieval org's image towers all downsample with fixed bilinear resize today. If swapping in MULLER buys even a fraction of a point of retrieval precision at zero serving cost, it's the cheapest quality win on the roadmap.

Milestones: mid-April — resizer integrated into one tower's input path, offline A/B on the retrieval eval set; mid-May — retraining sweep across the three main towers; Jun 1 — ship/no-ship recommendation.

Staffing and the compute/budget ask by Apr 10?

Anders
